title: Infrastructure Enters a Defining Era
summary: Professor Ali Jadbabaie explains how AI, climate change, and digital transformation are forcing a rethink of infrastructure design and management.

title: Single Pair Ethernet for Security Networks
summary: A whitepaper explores how Single Pair Ethernet overcomes legacy RS-485 limits to support AI surveillance and system convergence.

title: WorldOracle Tests Robot World Models
summary: WorldOracle tests show instances where a world model incorrectly predicted a successful fruit grasp despite the robot missing.

title: Virtual Power Plant Policy Scorecard
summary: Most US states received failing grades in a new Virtual Power Plant Policy Scorecard, with only six states earning a 'B'.

title: Extreme Spin May Cause Black Holes to Split
summary: New research suggests that single black holes could potentially split in two, but only if they are spinning at extreme speeds.

title: New Auto Kit Cleans City Air
summary: Researchers in South Korea developed an automotive kit designed to scrub roadside air and capture brake dust.

title: Intel Plans Quantum Business Acquisition
summary: Intel plans to acquire the quantum software platform Classiq to help build its quantum business.

title: FAA Seeks Advanced Spectrum Monitoring Systems
summary: The FAA is seeking ambitious monitoring systems to detect and geolocate aviation radio frequency interference and jamming.

title: Elektrobit and Microchip Streamline AUTOSAR Software
summary: The companies combined pre-integrated MCAL software and automation tools to reduce vehicle software integration complexity.

title: New Benchmark Evaluates AI Chip Design
summary: Build-A-Chip-Bench uses open-source tools to assess AI agents across the entire chip-design workflow from specification to GDS layout.

title: AI Role Grows in Analog Design
summary: Artificial intelligence is playing an increasingly important role in managing the rising complexity of analog and mixed-signal design.

title: Foundation IP Platforms Lower SoC Risks
summary: Integrated Foundation IP platforms help reduce integration delays and re-spin risks for HPC and edge AI SoCs.

title: Semiconductor Models Balance IP Secrecy and Accuracy
summary: Advanced packaging requires cross-boundary models that protect proprietary processes without breaking prediction accuracy.

title: Developing Computers with Superhuman Hearing
summary: Researchers are developing computer systems with superhuman hearing for speech recognition, music understanding, and environmental monitoring.

title: Modernizing Legacy Aircraft Power Architectures
summary: High-density switching supplies help modernize legacy aircraft power systems while addressing efficiency and integration challenges.

title: Arrowmax Unveils 52-in-1 Electric Smart Driver
summary: The new Arrowspace S1 electric smart driver uses an HD camera system to identify bits and automatically set torque ranges.

title: Underwater Spacewalk Simulations Test Astronaut Protocols
summary: Aquanauts conducted underwater simulated spacewalks to test astronaut safety and communication protocols during simulated missions.

title: Analog Superposition Increases PCM Storage Density
summary: Researchers demonstrated an analog phase-change memory architecture that stores multiple AI vectors in superposition to increase effective storage density.

title: Ukrainian Startup and GomSpace Test Satellite
summary: An experimental spacecraft launched on October 1 could lead to a future Ukrainian-controlled satellite communications network.

title: Cowboy Space Unveils Big Iron Rocket
summary: Cowboy Space revealed its Big Iron rocket, which is targeted for a late 2028 debut to build an AI data center constellation.

title: ThinkWorld Framework Enhances Robotic Dynamics Reasoning
summary: Researchers introduced a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics using reinforcement learning with world imagination.

title: Real-Time Heuristic for Autonomous Vehicle Coordination
summary: A bi-level optimization approach using algorithmic differentiation enables real-time coordination of connected and automated vehicles at intersections.

title: Evaluating Spatiotemporal Vision Models on Egocentric Tennis
summary: Researchers evaluated vision models on egocentric tennis video tasks to understand how spatiotemporal intelligence supports agile robots.

title: EgoThumb: Vision-Driven Supernumerary Robotic Thumb
summary: EgoThumb is a compact, open-source supernumerary robotic thumb that uses visual imitation learning to map egocentric camera images to continuous joint positions for grasp assistance.

title: Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: Constraint-Referenced Strategy evaluates manipulation policies by projecting end-effector twists onto object joint axes to separate progress from off-axis waste.

title: Longitudinal Retinal Imaging Improves Diabetic Retinopathy Prediction
summary: A retrospective cohort study demonstrates that multi-visit screening photographs improve the prediction of referable diabetic retinopathy and maculopathy.

title: Open-Source Hybrid Channel Simulator for Non-Terrestrial Networks
summary: Researchers propose an open-source hybrid channel simulation framework combining site-specific ray tracing with 3GPP statistical channel simulation for non-terrestrial networks.

title: Computing GR(1) Assume-Guarantee Contracts
summary: A new framework develops theory and algorithms to compute compositional assume-guarantee contract operations expressed in the GR(1) modulo theory.

title: Diagnosing Robot Failures in Bimanual Tool Use
summary: Researchers analyze sensing channels to diagnose bimanual tool-use failures such as slippage, timing discrepancies, and weak forces.

title: Passive Object Sensing via Distributed Sensing and Hyperdimensional Computing
summary: A proposed framework uses distributed wireless channel measurements and hyperdimensional computing to enable risk-aware passive entity sensing beyond robot line-of-sight.
